skills.description_zh: Through fixed cameras (with microphones) in the family living room or kitchen, the system monitors conflict events among family members in real time, identifying high-decibel arguments (sound intensity exceeding a threshold and lasting more than 10 seconds), door slams (object impact sound + door-frame vibration), and aggressive arm-swing actions.
